meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键发布 npm 包到注册中心
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要频繁地将 npm 包发布到线上。
copy.tagline_en: Publish npm packages to registry with one command
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to publish npm packages.

howto.what: 装上后,你要发布新版本时,Claude 会跑完整发布流程:检查未提交改动、同步远程、触发 GitHub Actions 发布工作流、等待构建通过、核对 npm 包和 GitHub 发布记录、撰写发布说明并尝试发到 Discord。全程只做发布,不审查或改代码。
howto.when: 当你说出「publish」「release」等触发词,并指定版本号升法(patch、minor 或 major)时触发;如果没给升法,它会先停下来问你。

say.note: 触发补丁版本发布流程

say.text: 帮我发布 minor 版本

howto.what_en: On a publish request, Claude runs the release workflow: check uncommitted, sync remote, trigger GitHub Actions publish, wait, verify npm/GitHub release, write release notes, post to Discord. Ship-only: no code review or fixes during a publish.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'publish', 'release', etc. and specify a bump type: patch, minor, or major. If no bump type is given, it stops and asks you for one.
